desktop.notes:
• Slideshow of your favourites ★ and albums: full screen, one photo at a time, random, with a slow fade and a gentle zoom in (sometimes out). Photos fill the screen with their shape kept; a portrait on a wide screen shows whole over a soft blurred copy of itself. Keeps can show too, less often.
• Starts by itself after 1 minute without mouse or keyboard; move the mouse or press a key to stop. Settings → General → Slideshow: on / off, the wait, keeps, and ▶ Play now. Also View → Slideshow (F11) and each album's menu.
• Send to Curish works from the portable Cullect (it opened a file browser instead).
• No more long freezes on big folders: while Cullect analyses a new folder you can keep scrolling and deciding (6,000 photos: the window used to stop for up to 17 s, now about 1 s). Scrolling, tabs (Undecided / All), search and the filters react about twice as fast; each K / D is quicker too.
• Less memory in the viewer: photos are shown at screen size and loaded in full only when you zoom in.
• Thumbnails while scrolling fast: the ones you are looking at load first; ones you scrolled past are skipped.
• Saving your decisions to the folder's .cullect file happens in the background - no hitch when you pause.
• Updates are signed: a new version is only installed when it carries Cullect's signature.
• Asks once before looking for updates on a new copy (Settings → Updates).
• About shows the licence and the open-source parts Cullect uses. Your Library and Curish stay where they are.
• Safer database upgrades: an interrupted upgrade can no longer stop Cullect from starting.
